My rambling points of why I've enjoyed it:

  • I've been playing it quite a bit with friends the past 2 weeks and it is fun to see how far you get and what equipment you'll get and how your situation differs each time, especially with friends

  • The matches are the exact right length: you either die quickly so you can get right back into it or it lasts around 20-30 minutes, so you don't get holdouts extending the game to ridiculous lengths

  • They're handling Early Access right, with frequent updates and an actual target release date. The game is already there, they're just still optimizing and adding new content

  • It boils down to the combat of survival games to keep it faster paced than a full-on survival games while still feeling very survival-oriented with the looting, large map, and tons of players. It's not survival in that you don't have to worry about food or water or anything except combat, but it still incorporates survival elements in a new way that's interesting and fun to play
